Messages.Author: cantila
Messages.Body:
A vamp has 1 blood and Anathema is played on him. I rush him and he
played Majesty and pays one blood to untap. If I rush him again but
make no dmg I'd guess he is not burned by Anathema? What if I send him
to torpor or burn him (decapitate)? Or if he steals one blood as I hit
him for one and he uses the stolen blood to prevent the damage?

Sent via Deja.com
http://www.deja.com/

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <91e3d1$l06$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,

cantila <rogc...@student.luth.se> wrote:
> A vamp has 1 blood and Anathema is played on him. I rush him and he
> played Majesty and pays one blood to untap. If I rush him again but
> make no dmg I'd guess he is not burned by Anathema? What if I send him

Correct.

> to torpor or burn him (decapitate)? Or if he steals one blood as I hit

He goes to torpor or is burned.

> him for one and he uses the stolen blood to prevent the damage?

Stolen blood won't prevent damage.
If he burns a blood to heal the damage, Anathema will burn him.
